name: Agent security: the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications (2026); spec ids SEC-A01 to SEC-A10 are ASI-01 to ASI-10 here
description: Agent security: the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications (2026); spec ids SEC-A01 to SEC-A10 are ASI-01 to ASI-10 here. From the Shio policy pack specification; draft, not reviewed.
limits: Draft and unreviewed. Planned controls are listed for coverage and not enforced.

controls.title: Goal hijack
controls.requirement: Goal hijack: model output is a reading and can't choose tools or targets; only code and sign-off decide.

controls.title: Tool misuse
controls.requirement: Tool misuse: typed tools, allow-listed arguments, limits, and run, hold or refuse gates.

controls.title: Each agent has its own least-privilege identity
controls.requirement: Each agent has its own least-privilege identity; no shared credentials.

controls.title: Supply chain
controls.requirement: Supply chain: pinned versions, signed manifests, SBOM, adapter trust classes, licence checks.

controls.title: No model-written code runs
controls.requirement: No model-written code runs; imported code is declared trusted and listed.

controls.title: Memory writes are typed
controls.requirement: Memory writes are typed, sourced and expiring; PHI in memory follows vault rules.

controls.title: Messages between agents are signed
controls.requirement: Messages between agents are signed, schema-checked and gated.

controls.title: Circuit breakers
controls.requirement: Circuit breakers, per-run budgets, and a hold after two consecutive failed checks.

controls.title: Readings show their basis
controls.requirement: Readings show their basis; rubber-stamp approvals are flagged.

controls.title: Signed records
controls.requirement: Signed records, baselines, a kill switch and replay catch a rogue agent.
